sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: At its core, Words is a word-based puzzle game where you're presented with a grid of letters and must create as many words as possible within a set time limit. The game features a unique set of rules, including the ability to use each letter only once, and the requirement to create words of a minimum length. As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new twists, such as blocked letters, bonus points, and power-ups. The goal is to clear the grid by creating as many words as possible, and the faster you clear the grid, the more points you'll earn. The game's mechanics are simple yet engaging, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body: If you're new to Words, here are some beginner tips and tricks to get you started: First, take your time and focus on finding the longest words possible. This will help you clear the grid quickly and earn more points. Next, make sure to use all the letters on the grid, as this will give you a bonus and increase your score. Finally, don't be afraid to experiment and try out different words. The game's hint system can be a lifesaver, providing you with suggestions and ideas to help you find the perfect word. Remember, practice makes perfect, so don't get discouraged if you don't do well at first – keep playing, and you'll soon become a word game master.

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body: Once you've mastered the basics, it's time to take your gameplay to the next level. Here are some advanced strategies to help you dominate the game: First, focus on finding high-scoring words, such as words that use all 7 letters on the grid. Next, use the game's power-ups strategically, such as the "remove a letter" power-up to get rid of a difficult letter or the "swap two letters" power-up to create a new word. Finally, make use of the game's bonus features, such as the "double points" bonus or the "clear the grid" bonus. Remember, the key to success is to stay focused and think strategically – with practice and patience, you'll become a Words master in no time.
